hints.title: Modulo 3 Examination
hints.text: Every number x has a remainder of 0, 1, or 2 when divided by 3.

hints.title: Single Step Modification
hints.text: If x % 3 is 1 (subtract 1) or 2 (add 1), exactly 1 operation produces a multiple of 3.

hints.title: Total Operation Count
hints.text: The total operations equal the count of elements in nums where x % 3 does not equal 0.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; linear pass is optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that any non-multiple of 3 is within 1 step of a multiple.
